objective: Retire purchase-based access checks for BUKLOD Cluster Daily Reading, Word and Lessons 101–107 while preserving active membership, stage progression and installed-client compatibility.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main SHA 7ce0f15ec1b748b3ddd6d869538ffe8c0c91699c on 2026-11-09. Production Supabase project yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu migration 20261109104024 applied and read back; MZB NAYON active member and nonmember cases tested. Android installed-client and OTA SHA not verified; source merge does not release.
chosenApproach: Replace only four existing backend compatibility functions through an additive migration; leave RLS/roles/payments/memberships untouched; keep client membership gate and update obsolete Premium copy. New focused SQL and Node tests enforce both positive and negative access.
selectionRationale: The application already disables paid checkout, but live Daily Reading and submission used a deprecated paid entitlement. Fixing the backend resolves installed clients without a forced app update and avoids bypassing the canonical cluster and lesson progression checks.
alternativeApproaches: Grant special MZB NAYON Premium or mark an MZB exemption (rejected: user-specific workaround contradicts retired premium policy).
Remove all cluster checks or grant unconditional client access (rejected: breaks membership, permissions and submission integrity).
Require new Android binary before changing backend (rejected: current installed clients depend on live RPC compatibility).
preserveBehaviors: Authentication, valid active Cluster membership and lifecycle remain mandatory for Daily Reading, Word and Lessons.
Stage prerequisites, repeat locks, learning progress, user privacy and RLS preserved.
Existing paid transactions, entitlement records, revenue and reward balances unchanged.
No new native runtime dependency and no client/OTA deployment without the separate release gate.
acceptanceChecks: MZB NAYON active member without Premium can load Daily Reading and Word, stage 101/107 available.
Nonmember remains denied by RPC; submission trigger still requires active Cluster.
Invalid stage 108 and Organization scope cannot become Cluster entitlement.
SQL regression runs read-only, Node source contract passes, no RLS/payment mutation.
Backend marked live only after migration and runtime read-back; OTA/web separately gated.
